title: Dune: War for Arrakis
scope: Setup and one full round, 2 players (Atreides vs Harkonnen), one phone; optional Desert War, Smugglers and Spacing Guild expansions

expansions.title: Desert War
expansions.summary: Escort Ornithopters, Suspensor Troopers, Fremen Camps, Rocket Launchers and Sandriders.

expansions.title: Smugglers
expansions.summary: A neutral spice-smuggling faction the Atreides can win over.

expansions.title: The Spacing Guild
expansions.summary: Heighliners, Space Frigates, Houses Major Troops and Imperium Actions.

images.caption: Wormsign effects: Sand, Sandworm, Burrowing Sandworm
Settlements: Arrakeen, Pyon Villages, Carthag, Sietches
Action dice: Atreides (black and green), Harkonnen (black and red)
House Atreides and Fremen Ally decks
House Harkonnen and Corrino Ally decks
CHOAM, Landsraad and Spacing Guild reference cards

steps.title: Lay out the board
steps.instruction: Put the two halves of the map board together in the middle of the table.

citations.excerpt: Arrange the two sections of the map board in the center of the game area.

steps.title: Place the Sietches
steps.instruction: Shuffle the 8 Sietch tokens facedown and put 1 on each Sietch symbol on the board. Only you, the Atreides, may look at their hidden side during the game.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the 8 Sietch tokens facedown and place them on the indicated Areas of the board, 1 token per Area.

steps.title: Garrison the Sietches
steps.instruction: Shuffle the Atreides Garrison Deployment tokens facedown. Put 1 token and 1 Naib Leader figure in each Area with a Sietch.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the Atreides Garrison Deployment tokens facedown and place 1 token and 1 Naib Leader figure in each Area containing a Sietch.

steps.title: Ready your Deployment tokens
steps.instruction: Shuffle the standard Atreides Deployment tokens and keep them facedown next to you.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the standard Atreides Deployment tokens and keep them facedown next to the Atreides player.

steps.title: Place the Settlements
steps.instruction: Put the 6 Harkonnen Settlements on their marked Areas: the 4 Pyon Villages, Carthag and Arrakeen. Their ratings are public.

citations.excerpt: Place the 6 Harkonnen Settlements (4 Pyon Villages, the city of Carthag and the planetary capital of Arrakeen) on the indicated areas of the board.

steps.title: Garrison the Settlements
steps.instruction: Shuffle the two sets of Harkonnen Garrison Deployment tokens separately, facedown. Put 1 token from each set in each Area with a Harkonnen Settlement. Flip them faceup and swap each token for the figures it shows. The legend on page 15 explains the symbols.
components: Harkonnen Regular, Elite and Sardaukar figures

citations.excerpt: Shuffle separately the two sets of Harkonnen Garrison Deployment tokens face down and place 1 token of each type in each Area containing a Harkonnen Settlement.
For example, this token deploys 1 Bashar Leader, 1 Sardaukar, and 1 Harkonnen Regular.

steps.title: Place the Testing Stations
steps.instruction: Shuffle the 6 Ecological Testing Stations facedown and put 1 on each marked Area. Nobody looks at them. A Station is revealed only when an Atreides Legion enters its Area.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the 6 Ecological Testing Stations facedown and place them on the indicated Areas of the board, one token per Area.

steps.title: Zero the score tracks
steps.instruction: Put the 3 Prescience markers on space 0 of the Prescience track, and the Supremacy marker on space 0 of the Supremacy track.

citations.excerpt: Place the 3 Prescience markers on the 0 space of the Prescience track. Place the Supremacy marker on the 0 space of the Supremacy track.

steps.title: Build the Prescience deck
steps.instruction: Shuffle all 16 Prescience cards into a facedown deck next to the board.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle all Prescience cards into a facedown deck placed next to the board.

steps.title: Make the Wormsign pool
steps.instruction: Shuffle the 16 Wormsign tokens facedown to form the Wormsign pool.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the 16 Wormsign tokens facedown to form the Wormsign tokens pool.

steps.title: Set up the dashboards
steps.instruction: Take your dashboard: Sietch Tabr for the Atreides, Giedi Prime for the Harkonnen. Put each named Leader card marked ‘in play at the start of the game’ on the Action box with the matching symbol. Keep the generic Leader cards (Naib and Bashar) and the other named Leader cards nearby.

citations.excerpt: Take your faction’s appropriate dashboard, placing all named Leader cards marked as ‘in play at the start of the game’ on the Action boxes showing the corresponding Action symbol.
the Giedi Prime dashboard for the Harkonnen player and the Sietch Tabr dashboard for the Atreides player.

steps.title: Set up The Spice Must Flow
steps.instruction: Put The Spice Must Flow board next to your Giedi Prime dashboard. Line up the 3 Imperium markers on the step marked ‘start here’.

citations.excerpt: The Harkonnen player takes the Spice Must Flow board and places it next to the Giedi Prime dashboard, lining up the 3 Imperium markers along the step marked ‘start here’.

steps.title: Swap in the Drone Ornithopters
steps.instruction: Replace the 3 Smugglers Planning cards in the House Atreides deck with the 3 Drone Ornithopters cards from this expansion. Remove the replaced cards from the game.

citations.excerpt: Replace the 3 Smugglers Planning cards in the House Atreides deck with the 3 Drone Ornithopters cards in this expansion

steps.title: Add the Guild Planning cards
steps.instruction: Add this expansion’s Planning cards to their matching decks, 3 per deck, before the decks are shuffled.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the Planning cards included in this expansion into their corresponding decks (3 for each deck).

steps.title: Shuffle the Planning decks
steps.instruction: Sort the Planning cards into four decks by their backs and shuffle each. The Harkonnen keeps House Harkonnen and Corrino Ally. The Atreides keeps House Atreides and Fremen Ally.

citations.excerpt: Shuffle the Planning cards into four separate decks based on their backs.

steps.title: Draw a Secret Objective
steps.instruction: Shuffle the 6 Secret Objective cards and draw 1. Put the other 5 back in the box. Keep your card hidden from the Harkonnen for the whole game.

citations.excerpt: The Atreides player shuffles the 6 Secret Objective cards and draws one of them (put the remaining 5 cards back in the box).

steps.title: Gather your pieces
steps.instruction: Keep your faction’s figures, Action dice, Combat dice, other tokens and reference cards within reach.

citations.excerpt: The players keep their faction’s figures, sets of Action dice, Combat dice, additional tokens and reference cards within reach.

steps.title: Ready the Desert War forces
steps.instruction: Keep the 2 Escort Ornithopters, the 6 Suspensor Troopers and the Suspensor Troopers / Escort Ornithopters reference card within reach. Put the Harkonnen Desert War reference card on the right side of your dashboard.

citations.excerpt: The Harkonnen player keeps the 2 Escort Ornithopters, the 6 Suspensor Trooper figures, and the Suspensor Troopers / Escort Ornithopters Reference card within reach

steps.title: Ready the Desert War forces
steps.instruction: Keep the 6 Rocket Launchers, the 2 Sandriders, the 3 Fremen Camp figures and tokens, and the Rocket Launchers / Sandriders reference card within reach. Put the Sandriders Leader card faceup on your Desert Power Action box and the Atreides Desert War card on the right side of your dashboard.

citations.excerpt: The Atreides player keeps the 6 Rocket Launcher figures, the 2 Sandrider figures, the 3 Fremen Camp figures and tokens
The Atreides player places the Sandriders Leader card faceup on the Desert Power Action box of their dashboard

steps.title: Set up the Smugglers
steps.instruction: Put the Smugglers board next to the main board with 1 Smuggler Regular and Gurney Halleck on it. Put the Staban Tuek figure on step 7 of the Prescience track. The Smugglers start neutral.

citations.excerpt: Place the Smugglers board next to the main game board, with 1 Smuggler Regular Unit on it, as well as Gurney Halleck.
Place the Staban Tuek figure on step 7 of the Prescience track.

steps.title: Take the Smuggler vehicles
steps.instruction: Add the 3 Smuggler Harvesters and the Smuggler Carryall to your available vehicles.

citations.excerpt: The Harkonnen player adds all 3 Smuggler Harvesters and the Smuggler Carryall to their available vehicles.

steps.title: Keep the Smuggler pieces ready
steps.instruction: Keep the Gurney Halleck and Staban Tuek cards and the 3 Smuggler Ornithopters at hand.

citations.excerpt: The Atreides player keeps the Gurney Halleck and Staban Tuek cards, as well as the 3 Smuggler Ornithopters near at hand.

steps.title: Set up the Space boards
steps.instruction: Attach the Space board and the two Heighliner boards to one side of the main board. Put each Heighliner on the starting space of its Heighliner board.

citations.excerpt: The Space and Heighliner boards can be assembled to either side of the main board.
Place the Heighliner figures on the starting space of their corresponding Heighliner Board.

steps.title: Load the first Troops
steps.instruction: Each player attaches a colour base of their faction to 2 Houses Major Troops and puts them on the Landsraad space of their Heighliner board. Keep the Space Frigates, the other Troops and colour bases, and the Guild Navigator card and figure at hand.

citations.excerpt: Players attach a color base of their faction to 2 Houses Major Troops and place them on the space of their Heighliner board with the Landsraad symbol.

steps.title: Check the Secret Objective
steps.instruction: Before anything else this round, compare your 3 Prescience markers with your Secret Objective card. If every marker has reached its target, the Atreides win. Destroying Arrakeen triggers this check at once.

citations.excerpt: The aim of the Atreides player is to reach a precise score with each of the 3 Prescience markers, as indicated on their Secret Objective card

citations.entry: Modified rule 2: immediate Atreides victory when taking Arrakeen
citations.excerpt: If they did, they win immediately (instead of at the End of the Round).

steps.title: Draw Planning cards
steps.instruction: Each player draws 1 Planning card from each of their two decks, 2 cards in total.

citations.excerpt: Both players draw 1 Planning card from each of their decks (2 cards total each).

steps.title: Reveal Prescience cards
steps.instruction: Draw 3 Prescience cards and lay them faceup in a row next to the deck, where both players can see them. The Atreides can claim up to 2 of them this round, as soon as a card’s requirements are met.

citations.excerpt: Draw 3 cards from the Prescience deck and place them faceup in a row next to the deck, within view of all players.
The Atreides player can claim a maximum of 2 Prescience cards each round.

steps.title: Grow the Smugglers
steps.instruction: While the Smugglers are neutral, add 1 Smuggler Regular to the Smugglers board. Once they have allied with the Atreides, skip this.

citations.excerpt: If Smugglers are neutral: Add 1 Smuggler Regular Unit to the Smugglers Board.

steps.title: Set aside Action dice
steps.instruction: Find the active row on The Spice Must Flow board: the row where your lowest Imperium marker sits. Set aside as many Action dice as its first column shows. They stay on your dashboard and aren’t used this round.

citations.excerpt: First, the Harkonnen player must set aside a number of their Action dice as indicated on the first column of the active row.

steps.title: Consider an Escort Ornithopter
steps.instruction: As you place Ornithopters, you may place 1 (only 1) Escort Ornithopter instead of a standard one. It can’t Scout or Troop-transport; it escorts Troops instead.

citations.excerpt: when placing 1 or more Ornithopters, the Harkonnen player may place 1 (and only 1) Escort Ornithopter instead of a standard one.
The Escort Ornithopter does not have the normal Scouting or Troop-Transport options.

steps.title: Place vehicles
steps.instruction: Take the vehicles the active row shows. Put Harvesters in free Desert Areas, 1 per Area. Put Ornithopters and Carryalls in Air Zones, 1 per Zone. A free Area has no enemy Settlements, enemy Units or Sandworms.

citations.excerpt: Harvesters are placed in free Desert Areas, 1 figure per Area.
An area is free for a player when it doesn’t contain enemy Settlements, enemy Units, or Sandworms.

steps.title: Place Smuggler vehicles
steps.instruction: While the Smugglers are neutral, you must also place every available Smuggler Harvester and the Smuggler Carryall, following the usual vehicle rules. If they have allied with the Atreides, the Atreides places Smuggler Ornithopters before your Carryalls and Ornithopters instead (Smugglers rulebook, page 7).

citations.excerpt: the Harkonnen player places all available Smuggler Harvesters and the Smuggler Carryall on the board, along with the other Harkonnen Harvesters (this placement is mandatory).
The Atreides player places all available Smuggler Ornithopters on the board (before the Harkonnen player places theirs).

steps.title: Place Desert War tokens
steps.instruction: Put a Desert War token on each empty slot of the first column of The Spice Must Flow board. Slots holding Action dice aren’t empty; tokens that don’t fit sit out this round.

citations.excerpt: At the end of each Vehicle Placement phase, the Harkonnen player places a Desert War token on each empty slot of the first column of the Spice Must Flow board.

steps.title: Place Fremen Camps
steps.instruction: Place every available Fremen Camp token facedown in an empty Desert Area, each in a different Sector, and put a Fremen Camp figure on each. Areas with a Camp are free for both players. A Harkonnen Legion entering one removes it.

citations.excerpt: At the start of each Action Resolution phase, the Atreides player places all available Fremen Camp tokens facedown in empty Desert Areas of their choice, each in a different Sector.
If a Harkonnen Legion enters an Area containing a Fremen Camp, that Fremen Camp token and figure are removed from the board.

steps.title: Roll Action dice
steps.instruction: The Atreides rolls 4 Action dice. The Harkonnen rolls every die not set aside. Put each die on the dashboard box that matches its result. If 4 or more of your dice show the same result, keep 1 and reroll the other matching dice (only once each round). If both players must change dice results because they exceed an Action box’s slots, choose the new results one at a time, taking turns, Harkonnen first.

citations.excerpt: The Atreides player rolls 4 Action dice throughout the game
Players getting the same result on 4 or more of their Action dice must keep 1 result and roll again the remaining matching dice (only once each round).

citations.entry: Order for changing dice that exceed the Action slots
citations.excerpt: The new die results are chosen one at a time, in turns, starting with the Harkonnen player.

additions.text: Once the Smugglers have allied with you, the Atreides also rolls the Smugglers Action die and puts it on the Smugglers board.

citations.excerpt: The Atreides player rolls the Smugglers Action die along with their other Action dice, then places it on the Smugglers board

loop.note: Action resolution ends once the Harkonnen has used every Action die. Any Atreides dice left are lost.

citations.entry: Can the Atreides act after the Harkonnen’s last die?
citations.excerpt: the Action Resolution phase is over once the Harkonnen player has executed all their available Actions.

steps.title: Action turn
steps.instruction: Take one Action. Spend 1 Action die on an Action its result allows, or spend any die to play a Planning card, or take a Desert Power Action with no die, if you have fewer unused dice than the Harkonnen. At any time in your turn you may reveal Deployment tokens (Guerrilla Training). When you finish, move each figure on your Regeneration Tank one step right. If nothing is left to do, tap Done.

citations.excerpt: Spend 1 Action Die to execute 1 of the Actions corresponding to its die result.
it can only be chosen if the Atreides player has fewer unused Action dice than the Harkonnen player.
The Atreides player can reveal any number of Deployment tokens on the board at any time during their Action turn.
Each time the controlling player ends an Action turn, all figures on their Regeneration Tank track are moved one step to the right.

additions.text: Each Desert Power Action also gives you a Desert War Action, before or after it: deploy 3 Rocket Launchers in Areas with a Fremen Camp, or make a Rocket Launcher special attack. When Desert Power places 2 Wormsigns, you may place 1 Sandrider instead of 1 of them, in an empty Desert Area.

citations.excerpt: Each time the Atreides player takes a Desert Power Action, they can also perform a Desert War Action, either before or after the Desert Power Action.
they can choose to place 1 (and only 1) Sandrider figure instead of 1 of the Wormsign tokens, in an empty Desert Area of their choice.

additions.text: A Legion that ends its move in an Area with a Smuggler Harvester captures it: remove it from the game and move Staban Tuek down 1 step. When any Prescience marker reaches Staban Tuek, the Smugglers ally with you (Smugglers rulebook, page 5).

citations.excerpt: the Harvester is captured and permanently removed from the game. For each Smuggler Harvester removed in this way, the Staban Tuek figure on the Prescience track is moved down 1 step.
The Smugglers faction allies with the Atreides when any Prescience marker reaches (or surpasses) the Staban Tuek figure on the Prescience track.

additions.text: When one of your Legions destroys a Harkonnen Harvester, take 1 Imperium Action at once: Spacing Guild (advance your Heighliner 1 step), CHOAM (put 1 Space Frigate on your Heighliner board) or Landsraad (put 2 Houses Major Troops on it). A Sandworm destroying it doesn’t count.

citations.excerpt: The Atreides player takes an Imperium Action of their choice immediately after using one of their Legions to destroy a Harkonnen Harvester, at any time during the round.
Using a Sandworm to destroy a Harvester doesn’t grant an Imperium Action.

additions.text: If a Heighliner reaches Arrakis, resolve its Landing at once: Troops go to empty Areas not adjacent to enemy Legions or Settlements, Frigates to different free Air Zones. Then the Heighliner returns to its start.

citations.excerpt: a special Landing phase is resolved immediately, interrupting whatever other phase of the game was in progress.
The player places all Troops in any empty Area of their choice that is not adjacent to enemy Legions or Settlements.

steps.title: Action turn
steps.instruction: Take one Action. Spend 1 Action die on an Action its result allows, or spend any die to play a Planning card. At any time this round you may remove an Ornithopter to reveal a Sietch in a connected Sector (Scouting). When you finish, move each figure on your Regeneration Tank one step right.

citations.excerpt: Spend any 1 Action Die to play a Planning card from their hand.
The Harkonnen player can remove an Ornithopter from the board at any time during a round to reveal a Sietch in a connected Sector

citations.entry: When do Named Leaders in the Regeneration Tank advance?
citations.excerpt: When do Named Leaders in the Regeneration Tank advance, exactly? A: At the end of the Action turn.

additions.text: Each time you spend an Action die, you may also discard 1 Desert War token from The Spice Must Flow board for a Desert War Action, before or after: deploy 3 Suspensor Troopers in empty Desert Areas of one Sector connected to an Air Zone with one of your Vehicles, or move 1 Suspensor Trooper, or remove one to reveal any Sietch and all Deployment tokens in 1 adjacent Area. An Escort Ornithopter in a connected Air Zone can carry a moving or attacking Legion like Troop-transport, then joins it as a Generic Leader.

citations.excerpt: each time the Harkonnen player spends an Action die, they may additionally discard 1 Desert War token from the Spice Must Flow board to perform 1 Desert War Action
Remove a Suspensor Trooper figure to reveal any Sietch and all Deployment tokens in 1 Area adjacent to it.
the Escort Ornithopter is immediately added as a Generic Leader to that Legion, being placed in its Area.

additions.text: If a Heighliner reaches Arrakis, resolve its Landing at once: Troops go to empty Areas not adjacent to enemy Legions or Settlements, Frigates to different free Air Zones. Then the Heighliner returns to its start.

citations.excerpt: a special Landing phase is resolved immediately, interrupting whatever other phase of the game was in progress.
The player places all Troops in any empty Area of their choice that is not adjacent to enemy Legions or Settlements.

steps.title: Remove Space Frigates
steps.instruction: Remove every Space Frigate still on the board and return it to its owner’s reserve.

citations.excerpt: Space Frigates still on the board at the end of the Action Resolution phase are removed before the start the Desert Hazards Phase.

steps.title: Place Wormsigns
steps.instruction: Without looking, draw Wormsign tokens and put 1 facedown in each Desert Area that has a Harkonnen Legion or Harvester and no Wormsign or Sandworm yet.

citations.excerpt: places them on the board, facedown without looking at them, 1 in each Desert Area that contains a Harkonnen Legion or Harvester and does not already contain a Wormsign token or Sandworm.

additions.text: Also put 1 Wormsign in each Desert Area with a Smuggler Harvester.

citations.excerpt: the Atreides player also places 1 Wormsign token in all Desert Areas containing a Smuggler Harvester.

additions.text: No Wormsign can go in an Area with Suspensor Troopers unless they share it with a Harkonnen Legion or Harvester.

citations.excerpt: No Wormsign tokens can be placed in an Area with Suspensor Troopers unless the Suspensor Troopers are in the same Area as a Harkonnen Legion or a Harvester.

steps.title: Reveal Wormsigns
steps.instruction: Flip every Wormsign token on the board and resolve them in any order. Sand: nothing happens. Sandworm: a Sandworm attacks or is placed. Burrowing Sandworm: the same, but only in Deep Desert. A token in an Area with an Atreides Legion or a Sandworm does nothing.

citations.excerpt: Then, the player flips all Wormsign tokens on the board faceup, and resolves their effects in any order desired

steps.title: Resolve Sandworms
steps.instruction: Only a Harvester there: remove it. The Harkonnen may remove a Carryall from a connected Air Zone instead: the Harvester stays and a Sandworm is placed in the Area too. A Harkonnen Legion there: roll Combat dice for a Sandworm attack, 5 in Deep Desert, 4 in Desert, 3 in Minor Erg or Plateau. If the Legion is destroyed, remove any Harvester there too. Empty Area: place a Sandworm. Then shuffle all Wormsign tokens back into the pool.

citations.excerpt: If the token is flipped in an Area containing only a Harvester, simply remove the Harvester.
the Harkonnen player can remove a Carryall from a connected Air Zone instead of removing the Harvester.
Deep Desert: 5 dice Desert: 4 dice Minor Erg or Plateau: 3 dice
After all Wormsign tokens have been resolved, they are shuffled back face down into the Wormsign pool.

additions.text: The Smuggler Carryall can save only Smuggler Harvesters, and Harkonnen Carryalls can’t save Smuggler Harvesters.

citations.excerpt: The Smuggler Carryall can only save Smuggler Harvesters.

steps.title: Roll for Coriolis Storms
steps.instruction: For each Harkonnen Legion in a Plateau, Minor Erg or Desert Area with no Harkonnen Settlement, roll Combat dice: 3 in Deep Desert, 2 in Desert, 1 in Minor Erg or Plateau. Each Hit or Special result is 1 hit. For each hit, the Harkonnen removes a Regular, swaps an Elite for a Regular, or removes a Leader.

citations.excerpt: All Plateau, Minor Erg, and Desert Areas on the board that do not contain a Harkonnen Settlement are subject to the fury of the Coriolis Storms.
Deep Desert: 3 dice Desert: 2 dice Minor Erg or Plateau: 1 dice
Replace 1 Elite Unit (Special or not) with 1 Regular Unit

additions.text: Desert Troopers can’t take hits from any source, including Coriolis Storms and Sandworms.

citations.excerpt: they cannot be inflicted any Hits from any source – including Coriolis Storms and Sandworms.

steps.title: Collect spice
steps.instruction: Remove every Harvester still on the board: 1 spice for each in Desert, 2 for each in Deep Desert. If you saved spice last round, you may discard the Spice Reserve token to add 1.

citations.excerpt: During this step, the Harkonnen player removes Harvesters still on the board to collect spice.
The Spice Reserve token can be discarded during any Spice Harvesting step to add 1 point to the total spice collected that round.

additions.text: Each Smuggler Harvester still on the board adds 1 spice, even in Deep Desert.

citations.excerpt: each Smuggler Harvester still on the board collects 1 spice point.

steps.title: Pay the Imperium
steps.instruction: For each Imperium marker, pay 2 spice to keep it where it is, or 3 to raise it one step (one step at most). Each marker you don’t pay for drops 1 step. You may save 1 spice for later by placing the Spice Reserve token, whether or not you paid for every marker. Then activate the Ban of every Imperium marker that just moved down, all of them, as each Imperium Bans card describes.

citations.excerpt: It costs 2 points to keep a token in the position it currently occupies
The Harkonnen player may choose to save a maximum of 1 spice point, to spend it for better effect in a following round.

citations.entry: Can you save spice without paying for every marker?
citations.excerpt: Can Stockpiling be done regardless of whether you keep the Imperium markers in place (or raise them)? A: Yes.

citations.entry: Modified rule 1: Imperium Ban limit removed
citations.excerpt: ALL Bans corresponding to markers that just moved down are activated.

additions.text: Paying 2 to keep a marker also gives you 1 Imperium Action of that power; paying 3 to raise it gives 2. Spacing Guild: advance your Heighliner 1 step. CHOAM: put 1 Space Frigate on your Heighliner board. Landsraad: put 2 Houses Major Troops, with your colour bases, on it.

citations.excerpt: If the Harkonnen player spends 2 Spice points to keep any Imperium marker in the position it currently occupies, they additionally take 1 Imperium Action associated to that marker.
If the Harkonnen player spends 3 Spice points to raise an Imperium marker up one step, they additionally take 2 Imperium Actions associated to that marker.

steps.title: Remove air vehicles
steps.instruction: Remove all Ornithopters and Carryalls still on the board. You can use an Ornithopter’s Scouting as you remove it.

citations.excerpt: Remove all Ornithopters and Carryalls still on the board (the Ornithopters’ Scouting ability can be used now, if possible).

additions.text: Also remove all Smuggler Vehicles still on the board.

citations.excerpt: Remove all Smuggler Vehicles still on the board.

additions.text: Also remove the Guild Navigator if it is on the board.

citations.excerpt: is removed together with other Vehicles at the End of the Round

steps.title: Clear the desert
steps.instruction: Remove all Escort Ornithopters, Fremen Camps and Desert Troopers still on the board, except Sandriders sharing an Area with a Sandworm.

citations.excerpt: all remaining Escort Ornithopters, Fremen Camps, and Desert Troopers (except for Sandriders in the same Area as a Sandworm) are removed from the board.

steps.title: Swap named Leaders
steps.instruction: You may replace any named Leader on the board with a generic Bashar. If no Bashar is left, the named Leader is still removed, with no replacement.

citations.excerpt: starting with the Harkonnen player, both players may replace any named Leader with a generic one.

citations.entry: Replacing a named Leader with no generic Leaders left
citations.excerpt: the Named Leader can still be removed, but is not replaced with any Generic Leader.

steps.title: Swap named Leaders
steps.instruction: You may replace any named Leader on the board with a generic Naib. If no Naib is left, the named Leader is still removed, with no replacement.

citations.excerpt: starting with the Harkonnen player, both players may replace any named Leader with a generic one.

citations.entry: Replacing a named Leader with no generic Leaders left
citations.excerpt: the Named Leader can still be removed, but is not replaced with any Generic Leader.

steps.title: Refresh Leader cards
steps.instruction: Put every spent named Leader card back on its Action box on your dashboard.

citations.excerpt: Place all ‘spent’ Named Leader cards back on the corresponding Action boxes on the player dashboards.

steps.title: Discard down to 6
steps.instruction: If you hold more than 6 Planning cards, discard down to 6. You choose which to discard.

citations.excerpt: Both players check their hand of Planning cards and discard down to 6 cards (if needed), choosing which cards to discard.

steps.title: Sort Prescience cards
steps.instruction: For the revealed Prescience cards nobody claimed, choose which to remove from the game. Shuffle the rest back into the Prescience deck.

citations.excerpt: The Atreides player chooses whether to remove from the game or reshuffle back into the deck any revealed but unclaimed Prescience cards.
Any remaining cards must then be reshuffled into the Prescience deck for the following round.

steps.title: Advance the Heighliners
steps.instruction: Move each Heighliner 1 step toward Arrakis. If one arrives, resolve its Landing now, Harkonnen first if both arrive, then return it to its starting space.

citations.excerpt: They automatically move 1 step at the end of each Round.
If the Heighliners of both players arrive on Arrakis at the same time, the Landing phase of the Harkonnen player is resolved first.
